name: sidebar-menu-flyout
title: Sidebar Menu Flyout
description: A sidebar row whose entries open in a menu beside it on hover or press — nested lists such as Spaces in the collapsed icon rail, with the row's count kept in sight.

meta.whenToUse: A nested list in the collapsed icon rail (Spaces and + New space), where an inline group has no room; railOnly keeps the expanded sidebar's own group.
meta.whenNotToUse: A row that goes somewhere on its own (SidebarMenuButton), a submenu inside the expanded sidebar (SidebarMenuSub), or the profile or workspace menu (DropdownMenu with a SidebarMenuButton trigger).
